remarks: Introducing this spacious, renovated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse that offers plenty of comfort. The living room features sliders to a balcony perfect a perfect spot to unwind. The unit boasts a large kitchen and a generous dining area. The master bedroom includes double closets, and a Jack & Jill full bath with both a stall shower and a tub separates the two bedrooms. Additional amenities include central air, in-unit laundry, and one assigned parking spot, with visitor parking available. Located near Oak Hills Golf Course, Calf Pasture Beach, and with easy access to major highways. Tenant to pay 1 month of security deposit and 1 month towards the agent's commission. See it soon!!!
